label: Kalakand
note: Chhena cooked down with milk, sugar and ghee, not cooked in syrup

about.text: Kalakand is a sweet cheese confection from India. It has been described as "akin to Italian cheesecake, firmer in texture than milk cake, but softer than burfis."
